name: Keeper of Oaths, Judge the Intrusion

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 Radiant Damage and suppress one ordinary magical Condition that target maintains on yourself or a willing ally until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.
End the suppressed Condition if it is ordinary and magical; Specialty and Wound Conditions remain.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Ancestor
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Ancestor Full Manifestation (FM-2A). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
